title: Apple Reportedly Developing AI Agent to Control Mac
excerpt: Apple is reportedly working on an AI agent designed to operate Mac computers, positioning itself to compete with other major industry models.
body_html: Apple is reportedly working on its own artificial intelligence agent capable of running a Mac computer. According to reports, the iPhone manufacturer is developing these agents to compete with existing systems from other companies, such as OpenAI Dots, Claude, Meta Muse, and Instinct.
